parts.t: Welcome to AXIS at Morgan Crossing! This immaculate top-floor unit offers one of the quietest, most private outlooks in the complex, with stunning North Shore Mountain views from every room. Featuring 2 bedrooms, 2 full baths, and a wide-open layout with bedrooms on opposite sides for privacy. The spacious kitchen boasts quartz counters, stainless steel appliances, and a 3-seat island—perfect for entertaining. Extras include high ceilings in the primary bedroom, an oversized balcony, in-suite laundry, underground parking, and a storage locker. All just steps from gyms, shopping, transit, restaurants, and coffee shops.
